name: ⚠️ Landing Experiments: Plane Crash Sandbox
desc:
❗ BEFORE YOU BUY ❗
Play the demo: https://www.roblox.com/games/59052853/Flight-Test-Physics

🔄️ Update: Added a new aircraft variant, a baseplate map, and more failure modes and aircraft components to interact with!

Landing Experiments is a plane crash sandbox, the only game in the genre with:
✅ Real-time mesh deformation,
✅ Semi-realistic flight & crash physics,
✅ Up to 5 failure modes per aircraft component, and
✅ Animated landing gear, wheels, and control surfaces!

Features:
🧑‍✈️ Pilot your airplane using semi-realistic flight controls
💥 Trigger failures individually across dozens of components!
✈️ Unlock up to 21 aircraft models and variants with full interiors
🎨 Customize your aircraft with almost 200 liveries!
⚡ Fly through procedurally generated weather patterns
🚨 Simulate crash response drills

Roblox Plus subscribers get 15% more Data Points.

This game is constantly being updated and improved. Your feedback is very welcome. Have fun!
